subject: PT deliverables runbook and test window request
messages:
From: Kate Monroe <kate@pentestco.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Proposed test window + deliverables checklist for Redwood Inference pen test

Hi Soojin —

Thanks again for choosing PentestCo for the upcoming external pentest. Attached is our current SOW (RIF_PT_SOW_v3.pdf) and a short deliverables checklist so we have alignment before the run.

Proposed test window: Nov 30 — Dec 3 (UTC offset noted below). We plan to run external blackbox and authenticated API testing across the public inference endpoints and the dedicated customer gateway.

High-level notes / open items for you to confirm:
- Confirm final scope: public inference endpoints (+ inference-private-api) and non-production staging cluster or exclude?
- Access method: prefer temporary IAM role + jump host; please confirm Okta SSO integration or provide bastion credentials.
- Callback scanning allowlist: we need a list of subdomains for our callback scanner.
- Deliverables: final report PDF, remediation spreadsheet CSV, and raw pcap/logs (raw logs require additional agreement).

Can you confirm the window and who will be the ops contact? Also let us know if you prefer an executive-summary-only external report vs. full technical disclosure.

Attachments: RIF_PT_SOW_v3.pdf (pdf)

Thanks,
Kate Monroe
Engagement Lead — PentestCo
kate@pentestco.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

--
PentestCo — Offensive security, responsibly delivered
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Kate Monroe <kate@pentestco.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Proposed test window + deliverables checklist for Redwood Inference pen test

On Wed, Nov 18, 2026 at 9:15 AM Kate Monroe <kate@pentestco.com> wrote:
> Hi Soojin —
>
> Thanks again for choosing PentestCo for the upcoming external pentest...

Thanks, Kate — quick confirmations below.

1) Test window: we cannot start on Nov 30 due to a scheduled infra maintenance. Please move the window to Dec 1–Dec 3 (inclusive). That still gives you three full days.

2) Scope adjustments (we've narrowed this since the SOW draft):
   - INCLUDE: public inference API (api.redwood.ai), inference-private-api (dedicated gateway), auth flows for API keys and OAuth CI flows.
   - EXCLUDE: on-prem analytics cluster (data lake) — that's out of scope for this run.

3) Access & credentials: Vivek will create a temporary IAM role and a jump host key. We'll use Okta-backed ephemeral access; credentials will be uploaded to our secure bucket with an expiry. Vivek, please confirm provisioning ETA.

4) Callback allowlist: we allow test callbacks to the following subdomains: test-callbacks.redwood.ai, staging-callbacks.redwood.ai. If you need wildcard, let me know.

5) Deliverables preference: Redwood asks for a redacted executive summary that can be shared externally and a full technical report uploaded to our secure drive for internal use. Raw logs are OK to share to the secure bucket but only if covered by a separate DPA amendment — we will route a DocuSign for that if needed.

I've started a runbook draft in Drive (link below) and attached a small markdown runbook excerpt (runbook_v1.4.md). Can we agree on a 48-hour Q&A window post-report and a retest window within 30 days for critical issues?

Runbook link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0B0r-unlisted-runbook-draft

Thanks — tagging Vivek for access provisioning.

Best,
Sooin Lee 
Senior PM, Security Programs
Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.ai

Attachment: runbook_v1.4.md (text)

Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Proposed test window + deliverables checklist for Redwood Inference pen test

Thanks for the quick responses. Dec 1–3 is fine on our end. A couple of follow-ups: 

- Callback allowlist: got it (test-callbacks.redwood.ai, staging-callbacks.redwood.ai). We'll use those.
- For deliverables: we'll produce the following by default unless you tell us otherwise:
   1) Client-facing executive summary (redacted) — PDF
   2) Full technical report — PDF
   3) Remediation spreadsheet — CSV
   4) Raw logs/pcaps — optional (requires DPA amendment)

Please confirm whether you want the executive summary redacted to omit specific CVE/path details for external sharing. We'll prepare a deliverables manifest for signature.

Also: can you confirm your preferred secure upload location (Drive folder vs S3 presigned upload)? We prefer S3 presigned for large pcaps; Drive is fine for PDFs.

I'm attaching a deliverables_manifest.xlsx for you to review.

Thanks — we'll plan resources for Dec 1 start and will await the jump-host credentials and the temporary role.

Kate

Attachments: deliverables_manifest.xlsx (xlsx)

Confirmed:
- Window locked: Dec 1–Dec 3 (UTC-aware schedule will be shared by Kate in her kickoff note).
- Deliverables: please produce the three core artifacts (exec summary redacted, full technical report, remediation CSV). Raw logs: we will sign a DPA amendment via DocuSign if needed — please expect a request.
- Upload locations: PDFs and CSV -> Drive folder (link below). Large pcaps -> S3 presigned upload (we'll provide presigned URLs).
- Q&A & retest: 48 hours for vendor Q&A post-final-report, retest window within 30 days for P1/P0 fixes.
- Callback allowlist confirmed: test-callbacks.redwood.ai, staging-callbacks.redwood.ai.

Vivek: please proceed with the credentialing items and share the secure bucket path and presigned URL owner. Hannah: I'll loop you for logistics and customer-facing comms; Elena (Acme Payments) is added to keep them in the loop on scope exclusions.
